Convert a group comparison to a data frame

Source: R/compare_groups.R
as.data.frame.transitiontrees_group_comparison.Rd

as.data.frame() returns one of the three tables of a compare_groups() result: the per-context tests, the omnibus tests, or the pairwise distances between groups.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'transitiontrees_group_comparison'
as.data.frame(
  x,
  row.names = NULL,
  optional = FALSE,
  what = c("pathways", "omnibus", "distance"),
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A transitiontrees_group_comparison object.

row.names, optional

Ignored.

what

"pathways" (default), "omnibus" or "distance".

...

Ignored.

Value

A data frame. For what = "pathways", one row per tested context, with the columns described in compare_groups(). For what = "omnibus", one row per axis with columns axis, statistic, value and p_value. For what = "distance", one row per unordered pair of groups with columns group_a, group_b and distance (the count-weighted symmetric Kullback-Leibler divergence of tree_distance(), nats).

See also

compare_groups(), summary.transitiontrees_group_comparison.

Examples

grp <- context_tree(group_regulation_long, actor = "Actor", time = "Time",
                    action = "Action", group = "Achiever", max_depth = 1)
cmp <- compare_groups(grp, iter = 20)
as.data.frame(cmp)
